definitions.explanation: A temporary hut put up on a beach for the summer swimming season, where people can change, rent a parasol, shower, and eat simple food.

examples.japanese: {海|うみ}の{家|いえ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{焼|や}きそば→焼きそば：13405_yakisoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: We had yakisoba at the beach hut.

examples.japanese: {海|うみ}の{家|いえ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{浮|う}き{輪|わ}→浮き輪：09261_ukiwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{借|か}りた→借りる：00532_kariru⟧。
examples.english: I rented a swim ring at the beach hut.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧{海|うみ}の{家|いえ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{海水浴|かいすいよく}→海水浴：10972_kaisuiyoku⟧⟦シーズン→シーズン：10944_shiizun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{終|お}わる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{解体|かいたい}→解体：06223_kaitai⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Beach huts, which only open in summer, are taken down when the swimming season ends.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
A fixture of the Japanese summer. Most open from about July to the end of August and serve the classic beach menu: ⟦{焼|や}きそば→焼きそば：13405_yakisoba⟧, ⟦{かき氷|かきごおり}→かき氷：10300_kakigoori⟧, ⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧, ⟦カレー→カレー：02898_karee⟧ and beer. The phrase also brings to mind a carefree summer holiday, and it appears in songs and TV dramas set by the sea.

- {海|うみ}の{家|いえ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{休|やす}む→休む：00606_yasumu⟧: to rest at a beach hut
- {海|うみ}の{家|いえ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦バイト→バイト：06955_baito⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to work part-time at a beach hut
